method.current: audited scores: auditor value where re-scored, team value where the auditor held it within tolerance
method.projected: published team/auditor projection where one exists; otherwise PM model: an aspect with >=1 APPROVED/APPROVED-WITH-EDIT row in 09-consistency/MASTER-CHANGES.csv rises to 88, capped at 80 while an owner/counsel row is pending; untouched aspects keep their score; page overalls use rubric page-type weights; areas are simple means across page types (rubric section 6)
method.overall: simple mean of the 16 area scores

areas.name: CTAs
areas.summary: One Calendly URL sits behind 2,683 links and 62 labels with no UTM; product, refinance and purchase hubs follow a sound primary/secondary pattern; Learn articles score 63 (D). Money-page score 77 (C).
areas.top_issue: 470 of 471 Learn pages have no action above the first H2, and 4 primary buttons promise a plan or checkup but open a calendar.

areas.name: Internal linking
areas.summary: No orphans and no broken internal links; click depth 2 via nav. Hubs are starved: /refinance/ has 5 contextual inlinks and /purchase/ 16; the menu prints 3 times; 349 pages lack visible breadcrumbs. Money pages 71 (C).
areas.top_issue: /refinance/ (5 contextual inlinks) and /purchase/ (16) are near-orphans while the menu duplicates about 45 links per page.

areas.name: External linking
areas.summary: 92% of citations go to government or primary sources. 69 policy violations on 60 pages, 171 Wikipedia links on 132 city pages, 136 http:// links, 15 rel-less sitewide links to alignwithalign.com. Money pages 79 (C).
areas.top_issue: Wikipedia and World Population Review used as sources on city pages; live status of about 11,290 external URLs could not be verified from the sandbox.

areas.name: Article linking
areas.summary: Learn articles link a hub on 87% and a money page on 92% of pages, median 17.5 to 19 inlinks, but money pages link down to only 2 to 6 guides, related modules show the same 3 posts on 50 pages and 29% have prev/next links.
areas.top_issue: Money pages do not link down into their clusters, and refinance/buying articles rarely link /refinance/ or /purchase/ (0 of 36).

areas.name: Core pages (67 scored)
areas.summary: Simple mean across 7 core page types (home 71, purchase 69, refinance 74, product 75, calculator 74, research 80, trust 78). Money-page score 72 (C) projected 88 (B).
areas.top_issue: The purchase section averages 69 (D): 8 of 12 H1s are slogans, 8 of 10 sub-page titles omit Michigan, and the home page is the weakest money page at 71.

areas.name: Headings (H1/H2/H3)
areas.summary: Home page 56 (0 question headings, link-group labels and 13 county names as H2/H3); city template marks about 1,000 stat values as H3s; Learn outlines are bloated (median 17 H2s) with a 5-heading template tail on about 420 pages.
areas.top_issue: Brand-line H1s on purchase sub-pages and stat values marked up as headings on all 276 city pages.

areas.name: Above-the-fold answers
areas.summary: Money pages mostly have a next step but rarely the who/answer/why-Align trio within 60 words; purchase sub-pages 62; Learn pages run 224 to 429 words above the first H2 with no action.
areas.top_issue: Learn pages hold most impressions yet 470 of 471 have no answer box or action above the first H2; only the top 50 get the new answer box in this release.

areas.name: Titles and meta descriptions
areas.summary: Titles are within length and unique almost everywhere; purchase (61) and refinance (66) titles omit the query words; 111 city metas are under 140 characters and 17 quote a different price than the page; Learn titles carry Title-Case errors on 82%.
areas.top_issue: Non-brand top-10 queries earn 0.08% CTR (8 clicks on 10,665 impressions): titles do not match the query or give a reason to click.

areas.name: City page accuracy
areas.summary: About 8,300 claims checked against Census, ACS, Michigan Treasury and county sources. 59 tax-share errors, PRE "May 1" on 3 pages, a stale Highland Park millage, EMU and U-M figures, Oxford ZIP placement, 14 pages with fair-housing words.
areas.top_issue: Material errors were under-penalized by the teams (they scored 90 to 95.5); the independent auditor re-scored the 276-page set at 82 (B).

areas.name: City page consistency
areas.summary: Trust/NAP 100% consistent on 276 of 276; median unique text 68% (no doorway risk); titles and H1s on one pattern. Drift: 17 meta price mismatches, Northville gives three county answers, Blair Township on no hub, 40 pages only under /additional-cities/.
areas.top_issue: Meta descriptions and hero values mix Census, Redfin and Zillow measures; the fix waits on owner decision D2.

areas.name: Blog library (Learn)
areas.summary: 424 articles (median 5,604 words) and 49 hubs earned 50,180 impressions and 4 clicks; 61 cannibalization groups, 38 drift articles; the plan shrinks the library to 316 indexable articles and adds 14 Michigan-specific posts.
areas.top_issue: Volume is not the gap: the library reads as scaled content (all re-dated in five weeks) while the real gaps are narrow Michigan program topics.

areas.name: Keyword gap coverage (GSC; Bing not connected)
areas.summary: 5,231 GSC queries analysed: 511 in striking distance, 79.5% of on-topic impressions at position 21 or worse. Every evidenced gap now has one owner URL (147 query themes). Bing Webmaster data was never connected, so Bing gaps are unmeasured.
areas.top_issue: No Bing data; GSC has no page dimension in the connector, so most query-to-page mappings are inferred (26 of 147 confirmed).

areas.name: Images and media
areas.summary: 1,244 images audited; 1,977 optimized files built (WebP, 1600/1200/768 widths); the 746 replaced files drop from 101.1 MB to 64.2 MB. Home LCP is a 218 KB CSS background behind Motion Effects; 314 pages lazy-load the 52-px headshot above the fold.
areas.top_issue: Home page Media 61 to 63 (D): the LCP image waits on JavaScript and has no preload or srcset.

areas.name: E-E-A-T and trust
areas.summary: Bylines, NMLS, six-state licensing and Sources lists are strong; product pages (70) lack a visible reviewer line and updated date; 142 of 424 articles carry a verbatim Samantha quote.
areas.top_issue: NAMB Broker of the Year appears on 18 pages with no year or primary source; the guide byline claim must match the Editorial Policy (F8).

areas.name: AI-search readiness
areas.summary: FAQPage and question H2s on 469 of 471 Learn pages; but the canonical entity sentence is on 0 of the 15 top money pages, research pages have no question answers, and Align is cited on 4 of 12 tracked prompts (5 of 48 engine checks).
areas.top_issue: Align is absent on all four AI engines for both property-tax uncapping prompts, although its 2026 Uncapping Study is the best Michigan dataset on the topic.

areas.name: Brand voice and compliance
areas.summary: Live site: Accuracy & compliance averages 80 across page types (home 60). Team draft copy scored 69 (D) before the brand pass; after 290 brand fixes and the resolver re-screen it projects 93 (A). Voice of team copy 83 (B).
areas.top_issue: P0 compliance items on the live site: a "rates as low as 1%" USDA meta, no government non-affiliation line on 8 FHA/VA/USDA pages, a stale 1.5% tax default, "620 minimum", a "great rates" review and an unverified award.
